# Masked transitions of RGSS2 measured on the original runtime of VX (RGSS202E 2.0.2.1 and
# 2.0.0.1, 2026-10-12, report vx-v1-sprite-REPORT.md section 5, per-step values of
# vx-v1-mask-steps.txt): `Graphics.transition(N, mask, vague)` from white to black with a
# mask whose level is its column, 0 to 255. A shown level is the weight of the white picture.
#
#   N VAGUE STEP FIRST W FULL NEXT...
#
# VAGUE is `default` where the argument was omitted, which RGSS2 takes as 40. Of step STEP,
# FIRST is the lowest mask level that shows more than black and W what it shows, FULL the
# lowest level that shows white, and NEXT what the six levels from FIRST on show; `-` where
# there is none, as at step N, which is the black picture alone. The measured transition with
# a negative vagueness is left out.
